deferred_source_units.reason: The unit says there is no word on the tongue and continues into the next unit’s divine knowledge. It does not itself state that God knows an unspoken word. No independent retained comparison is established without importing that familiar formulation.

Darkness trampling the speaker and night as light in his delight have an unusual stated relation. A general darkness-and-light passage would risk resolving these clauses beyond their wording; the separate 138:12 comparison does not settle this unit.

The unworked substance, book, future formation over days and none among them are preserved without supplying an unstated antecedent or identifying a particular book. The examined Exodus book passage does not establish the proposed identity.

The source explicitly speaks of Thy friends and their strong beginnings. It is not replaced by a statement about God’s thoughts. A comparison merely with holy ones or honored people does not establish a particular relationship.

The plural counted beyond sand follows the friends and beginnings language, then the speaker awakes still with God. Identifying the plural with thoughts or descendants would exceed the actual wording; no particular supported comparison is retained.

The wording about speaking into deliberation and taking Thy cities into vanity is preserved. No named city, event or familiar alternative wording has been established to support an independent comparison.

This native unit consists only of the general For the end and psalm for David heading. Repetition of this common heading alone does not establish a sufficiently particular relationship or historical occasion.

The Lord’s overshadowing of the head on the day of war is specific, but the examined Isaiah helmet passage describes the Lord putting a helmet on His own head. Equating the psalm’s covering with that armor would add an unstated object and change the wearer.
The judges swallowed beside a rock and the future hearing of sweet words do not identify a specific narrative judgment. No rock episode is assigned on the basis of shared scenery alone.

The full storehouses and sheep multiplying are kept in their own whose/their sequence. The researched general agricultural richness does not establish this particular combined scene or the owners’ identity.
Fat oxen, no collapse of a fence, no passage out and no cry in squares remain as written. No particular historical security scene or unexpressed translation of these clauses is established.

The original Daniel 7:14 proposal shared broad kingdom, glory and authority language but not a sufficiently particular relation once the different recipients and actions were preserved. It was removed. The separate enduring-kingdom comparison at 144:13 supplies no completion credit here.

Strengthened gate bars and blessed children in Jerusalem are not explicitly tied to Nehemiah’s gate-watch orders. The inspected narrative says the doors were wedged fast and guards appointed; that does not identify this praise with the narrated event.

The sent oracle and swiftly running word require a more particular counterpart than the general effectiveness of God’s sent word. The inspected Isaiah rain-and-word comparison does not expressly state the running or speed.
The young men, young women, old and younger people extend the praise summons across ages. No particular independent assembly or ritual is identified merely from such a general enumeration.

The written judgment remains unnamed. The examined vengeance statement in Deuteronomy does not establish that it is the exact written judgment intended here; no particular document or execution event is credited.
